ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE

Behind the image
73 / Lace Back
REFERENCE 5939.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 053
Art direction: Blue-grey studio backdrop, black and olive utility tones, a low, relaxed pose with
strong contour and a soft key light.
Photorealistic vertical studio fashion portrait of an original adult woman in a crouched, relaxed
pose, long glossy dark hair falling forward over one shoulder, a soft gaze toward the camera and
natural makeup. She wears a fitted black sleeveless top with a corset-style lace-up back, an
olive-green utility mini skirt with a wide D-ring belt that trails down, and tall black leather platform
knee boots with chunky lug soles. Smooth blue-grey seamless studio backdrop, soft directional key
light creating gentle contour on the arms and legs, muted black and olive palette, clean urban
editorial styling, no text or logos.
74 / Velvet Rose
REFERENCE 5935.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 053
Art direction: Black velvet against a soft blush backdrop, a poised, direct-to-lens pose and a single
bloom as the only accent.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter studio portrait of an original adult woman with dark brown
hair pinned into a high, smooth bun with a few soft face-framing strands, defined brows, winged
eyeliner and a calm, direct gaze with soft rosy lips. She wears a short black velvet dress with fitted
puffed shoulders, long sleeves with flared cuffs, and a sheer black-trimmed illusion neckline. She
holds a single pale pink rose low in front of her, hands loosely crossed. Soft blush-pink seamless
backdrop with a deep burgundy fabric fold at the edge of frame, even diffused studio light, black
and blush palette, velvet texture, polished red-carpet editorial, no text, watermark or logos.
